# keystore_module

> Keystore: scrypt vaults, BIP39/BIP32 HD derivation, secp256k1 signing. No network; private keys never leave the module.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `configure` | `configure(config_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Name who holds the two roles: `{ approver?, custodian? }` → `{ ok, approver, custodian }`. |
| `create_mnemonic` | `create_mnemonic(words: int) -> tstr` | Generate a fresh BIP-39 mnemonic of `words` (12/15/18/21/24) — `{ ok, phrase }`. |
| `import_mnemonic` | `import_mnemonic(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Derive + persist an account from a mnemonic, creating its derivation group. |
| `derive_next_account` | `derive_next_account(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Add the next account of a derivation group, without the phrase. |
| `derive_account_at` | `derive_account_at(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Add one account at a chosen index. |
| `preview_addresses` | `preview_addresses(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Addresses a group would derive, without writing anything and without a network. |
| `create_unrelated_account` | `create_unrelated_account(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | The ONE way to obtain a random key — a key no recovery phrase covers. |
| `forget_derivation` | `forget_derivation(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Stop keeping a group's derivation key. |
| `remove_group` | `remove_group(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Remove a wallet's record and its name. |
| `list_groups` | `list_groups() -> tstr` | Derivation groups, `{ ok, groups: [...] }`. |
| `list_derivation_keys` | `list_derivation_keys() -> tstr` | What the key directory holds: `{ ok, groups, staged, unexplained }`. |
| `get_provenance` | `get_provenance() -> tstr` | Where each account came from, `{ ok, accounts: { <address>: {...} } }`. |
| `get_account_wallets` | `get_account_wallets() -> tstr` | Wallet ownership for account pickers, `{ ok, wallets: { <address>: { wallet, index? } } }`. |
| `settle` | `settle() -> tstr` | Bring the keystore directory to a state the layout explains, and report both what it DID and what is left: `{ ok, swept, promoted, unexplained, links, staged, importStages }`. |
| `remove_unexplained` | `remove_unexplained(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Remove one path `settle`/`list_accounts` reported as unexplained. |
| `import_private_key` | `import_private_key(priv_hex: tstr, password: tstr) -> tstr` | Import a raw private key (hex), persisted under `password` → `{ ok, address }`. |
| `import_keystore_json` | `import_keystore_json(key_json: tstr, password: tstr, new_password: tstr) -> tstr` | Import a scrypt keystore JSON, re-encrypted under `new_password` → `{ ok, address }`. |
| `export_keystore_json` | `export_keystore_json(address: tstr, password: tstr) -> tstr` | Export an account's scrypt keystore JSON (requires its password) → `{ ok, keystore }`. |
| `list_accounts` | `list_accounts() -> tstr` | `{ ok, accounts: [address, ...] }`. |
| `has_address` | `has_address(address: tstr) -> bool` |  |
| `delete_account` | `delete_account(address: tstr, password: tstr) -> bool` |  |
| `change_password` | `change_password(address: tstr, old_password: tstr, new_password: tstr) -> tstr` | Re-encrypt a vault under a new password. |
| `set_label` | `set_label(address: tstr, label: tstr, password: tstr) -> tstr` | Name an account, or clear the name with an empty string. |
| `get_labels` | `get_labels() -> tstr` | Account names, `{ ok, labels: { <address>: <name> } }`. |
| `set_group_label` | `set_group_label(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Name a wallet, or clear the name with an empty string. |
| `get_group_labels` | `get_group_labels() -> tstr` | Wallet names, `{ ok, labels: { <groupId>: <name> } }`. |
| `request_approval` | `request_approval(intent_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Ask a human to approve signing. |
| `approval_status` | `approval_status(handle: tstr, receipt: tstr) -> tstr` | Bare state for the requester — never the intent, never the results. |
| `fetch_result` | `fetch_result(handle: tstr, receipt: tstr) -> tstr` | Collect the signatures. |
| `ack_result` | `ack_result(handle: tstr, receipt: tstr) -> bool` | The requester has the signatures; erase them. |
| `cancel_approval` | `cancel_approval(handle: tstr, receipt: tstr) -> bool` | The requester gave up. |
| `pending` | `pending() -> tstr` | Queue summaries — never leg detail. |
| `acknowledge` | `acknowledge(handle: tstr) -> tstr` | Claim a request for display. |
| `approve` | `approve(handle: tstr, bundle_id: tstr, password: tstr) -> tstr` | The human said yes. |
| `reject` | `reject(handle: tstr) -> bool` | The human said no. |
| `caller_identity` | `caller_identity() -> tstr` | Observability: what this module currently sees as its caller. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `accounts_changed` | `accounts_changed(count: int)` | Anything a reader shows about the accounts moved — the set itself, or the names and wallets it is displayed under. |
| `approval_offered` | `approval_offered(handle: tstr)` | A new request is waiting. |
| `approval_settled` | `approval_settled(handle: tstr, state: tstr)` | A request reached a terminal state. |
